# Fanwei Helper v8

The Windows x64 and macOS Apple Silicon packages are published as assets of
the GitHub release below so large runtime binaries do not inflate Git history:

https://github.com/atachenjun-cm/easy-exam-automation/releases/tag/fanwei-helper-v8-20260811

Both packages are configured for the shared console at
`http://172.16.13.214:8765` and expose helper version 8.

Verify downloaded packages with `SHA256SUMS` before installation.
